title: The Bitter herb in the cup
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：bitter　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bitter 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the writer wrote of ① a bitter herb in the cup in the manuscript, and everybody in the study said at once that it was ② so bitter that nobody in the study would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the writer, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the bitter ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the bitter herb in the cup that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manuscript for January 1952 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too bitter to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the reader who had come to help; the bitter ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a bitter memory of that winter, and said that no reader in his right mind would call it ⑥ as bitter as the memory of that winter they had once had in the old study. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was bitter or not, and he said so.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript. What the line asked for was ⑦ something bitter, and nothing besides. The reader from the next study called the whole plan ⑧ quite bitter; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manuscript kept the names of the bitter ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968, twice over, she wrote of another bitter herb in the cup in the same manuscript, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less bitter than anybody had expected. ⑩ The bitter memory of that winter that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1970, was the one she could never quite name; the bitter ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 苦（前置定语 a bitter herb in the cup：1958 年写作者在手稿里记下的那件苦的草药）
B. adj. 苦／痛苦（两处加强说法：so bitter that … 与 no less bitter than …）
C. adj. 苦／痛苦（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 苦（表语 too bitter to do：母亲觉得它太苦，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 痛苦（前置定语 a bitter memory of that winter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩痛苦的记忆）
F. adj. 痛苦（同级比较 as bitter as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那年冬天的记忆相比）
G. adj. 痛苦（后置定语 something bitter：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 痛苦（受程度副词修饰 quite bitter：那位读者的评价）

items.q: a bitter herb in the cup
the bitter herb in the cup that
a bitter memory of that winter
The bitter memory of that winter that

answers.why: bitter 意为“苦”，1958 年写作者在手稿里记下的是“一件苦的草药”，此处作前置定语 a bitter herb in the cup。
bitter 意为“苦”，此处用 so bitter that 结构，说它苦到书斋里没人敢靠近。
bitter 意为“苦”，手稿上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的苦杯里的草药，等于最高级的说法。
bitter 意为“苦”，母亲认为这件东西“太苦了，谁也用不上”，too bitter to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
bitter 意为“痛苦”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩痛苦的记忆”，此处作前置定语 a bitter memory of that winter。
bitter 意为“痛苦”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那年冬天的记忆一样痛苦”，同级比较用 as bitter as。
bitter 意为“痛苦”，手稿上那半行字要的是“痛苦的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something bitter。
bitter 意为“痛苦”，邻书斋来的那位读者认为这套计划“相当痛苦”，quite 修饰原级 bitter。
bitter 意为“痛苦”，no less bitter than 表示“其痛苦不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之痛苦不亚于任何人的预料。
bitter 意为“痛苦”，母亲 1970 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的痛苦记忆”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，写作者在手稿里记下了一件苦的草药。（a bitter herb in the cup）
它苦到书斋里没有一个人敢靠近。（so bitter that …）
母亲觉得它太苦，谁也用不上。（too bitter to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩痛苦的记忆。（a bitter memory of that winter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那年冬天的记忆一样痛苦。（as bitter as …）
到了 1965 年，手稿上只剩半行字：要的是一件痛苦的东西。（something bitter）
answers: In 1958 the writer wrote of a bitter herb in the cup in the manuscript.
It was so bitter that nobody in the study would go near it.
My mother thought it too bitter to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a bitter memory of that winter.
He said nobody would call it as bitter as the memory of that winter they had once had.
By 1965 the manuscript asked for nothing but something bitter.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bitter 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the writer wrote of a bitter herb in the cup in the manuscript, and nobody forgot it.
It was the bitter herb in the cup that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manuscript says.
My mother thought it too bitter to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a bitter memory of that winter, and nobody argued with him.
The reader from the next study called the plan quite bitter, and everybody laughed.
The bitter ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
